scope: one torchvision R(2+1)D-18 non-RD vs RD comparison under the inherited U-Net++ recipe; not an ERDES paper-row reproduction

model.name: torchvision_r2plus1d_18_grayscale_binary
stem: BatchNorm3d(45, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
BatchNorm3d(64, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, bias=True, track_running_stats=True)
model.initialization: builder defaults for all modules; replacement stem[0] uses kaiming_normal_(mode='fan_out', nonlinearity='relu'), the builder's Conv3d rule. fan_out (45*1*7*7) does not depend on input channels, so the replacement uses the same initialization distribution as the stock first convolution
model.head: AdaptiveAvgPool3d(1), flatten, Linear(512,1); squeeze to [B] raw logits
model.version_note: installed torch/torchvision versions are recorded in runtime.json; parameter count verified with torchvision 0.29.2

evaluation.test_policy: no test access in training; new official-test inference only after the team freezes all choices, disclosed as reused official benchmark

cache.reuse: attached read-only U-Net++ CPU preparation outputs validated by rd_ultrasound_ml.video_cache.load_cache_for_run
cache.pin_evidence: digest recomputed from the tracked kaggle_unetpp_preparation notebook config plus embedded-module SHA256s; equals training_config_digest and training_data_fingerprint in configs/unetpp_rd_002_evaluation.json

training.checkpoint_selection: highest validation accuracy; earliest on ties
training.normalization_note: BatchNorm3d sees each physical batch only; gradient accumulation does not make BatchNorm observe 48 clips

disclosures: Architecture comparison under the inherited U-Net++ recipe (Adam 1.5e-5, 50 epochs); not this architecture's tuned best performance. The small learning rate may disadvantage R(2+1)D-18.
torchvision R(2+1)D-18 is not a named ERDES Table 8 row; no paper reproduction is claimed.
Only stem[0] input channels change (3 to 1); weights=None, no Kinetics transforms, no pretrained weights.
Model uses BatchNorm3d (U-Net++ used InstanceNorm3d); with physical batch 4 BatchNorm statistics use 4 clips per forward pass. Not a normalization-controlled ablation.
FP16 autocast with FP32 master parameters and GradScaler, after a real-input finite-gradient probe; not bit-identical FP32 training.
Inputs reuse the verified U-Net++ float32 cache; the preparation identity is pinned separately from this training identity.
Official splits are clip-level with possible same-patient overlap; one seed; no unseen-patient or clinical-validation claim.
Only CUDA device 0 is used; bounded resumable Kaggle jobs; the official test set was already exposed at project level.
